{
  "ledger": [
    "Initial kitchen cabinetry and microwave | Upper and lower cabinets with a countertop microwave stand to the right of the passage | Leave view as the camera follows the woman toward the passage | Camera translation reveals the microwave beside her, then carries it beyond the right edge; she occludes the cabinets behind her.",
    "Initial kitchen range, sink, and window | Range and hood occupy the passage's left side; sink and window lie farther along that same side | Remain on the left until the camera turns toward the bedroom | Forward movement reveals successive portions of the counter in compatible depth order.",
    "Initial passage and exterior door | A glazed exterior door terminates the passage ahead; a framed portrait hangs on the wall to the passage's right | Door recedes toward screen left during the rightward turn | The bedroom opening appears to the right of the portrait wall; the woman passes in front of the wall and its pictures.",
    "Bedroom entrance | White-trimmed opening lies to the right of the initial passage's portrait wall | Camera and woman pass through it; its jambs leave view | Bed, chandelier, and windows are progressively revealed within the opening, with the nearer jambs masking the room's edges.",
    "Bedroom bed and bedside furniture | Bed projects from the far wall toward the entrance; lamp and bedside table stand to the headboard's left | Bed shifts toward screen right as the camera turns left across its foot | Woman remains nearer the camera and occludes portions of the bed; the headboard, lamp, and wall art retain their relative arrangement.",
    "Bedroom chairs and rug | Two wooden chairs stand along the bed's foot over a rug extending beneath the bed | Chairs and bed leave view to the right during the turn toward the next doorway | Successive angles expose the chairs separately; their silhouettes overlap the farther bed consistently.",
    "Bedroom windows and chandelier | Curtained windows occupy the headboard wall's right portion and the adjacent left wall; chandelier hangs above the bed area | Adjacent-wall window becomes prominent beside the exit; chandelier passes out above | Leftward camera rotation carries the headboard-wall window off to the right and brings the adjacent wall into frontal view.",
    "Bedroom exit wall | A second doorway appears left of the adjacent-wall window; a small table with a framed photograph and a landscape picture occupy the space between doorway and window | Doorway fills the view as the woman approaches; table and landscape move toward the right edge | Door trim occludes the next room's margins, and the woman occludes the doorway's central background.",
    "Final narrow kitchen | Through the bedroom exit, a glazed door is visible straight ahead | Range and wall-mounted microwave are on the left, window on the right, glazed door at the far end | Entering reveals more of both side walls with compatible parallax; the footage does not establish that this is the initial kitchen."
